name: 91763 · Montclair, CA
findings: ZIP 91763 (Montclair) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91763 (Montclair) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91763 (Montclair) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
